title: Power Rankings: Rockets join Texas teams at the top; Lakers back in top 10
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Week 21
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Mavs are a mere 6-0 since Suns loss, but Dirk senses you're not impressed: ''We win 17 in a row, lose one game and . . . everybody says we're nothing.'' Not us, pal.
rankings.summaryText: Mavs are a mere 6-0 since Suns loss, but Dirk senses you're not impressed: ''We win 17 in a row, lose one game and . . . everybody says we're nothing.'' Not us, pal.

rankings.summaryHtml: Shocker: Spurs have been better in the second half (21-7) than they were in the first half (28-13). It's only happened five seasons out of six this millennium.
rankings.summaryText: Shocker: Spurs have been better in the second half (21-7) than they were in the first half (28-13). It's only happened five seasons out of six this millennium.

rankings.summaryHtml: Suns just clinched their third straight division title after winning only three from 1968-2004. One caution: Suns' lead over Spurs for the No. 2 seed is down to three games.
rankings.summaryText: Suns just clinched their third straight division title after winning only three from 1968-2004. One caution: Suns' lead over Spurs for the No. 2 seed is down to three games.

rankings.summaryHtml: Rockets are 8-3 with Yao back and have held 25 opponents to 85 points or fewer. Those are two variables in a formula adding up to a win total that would lead the East.
rankings.summaryText: Rockets are 8-3 with Yao back and have held 25 opponents to 85 points or fewer. Those are two variables in a formula adding up to a win total that would lead the East.

rankings.summaryHtml: Pistons are 2-0 when Sheed is serving a techs-induced suspension and just clinched the East's first playoff berth. So they're not stressing about a so-so home record.
rankings.summaryText: Pistons are 2-0 when Sheed is serving a techs-induced suspension and just clinched the East's first playoff berth. So they're not stressing about a so-so home record.

rankings.summaryHtml: Just when it seemed they were pushing for the East's top seed, Cavs post a 1-3 week. Which puts them closer to No. 5 than No. 1, with seven of the next eight on the road.
rankings.summaryText: Just when it seemed they were pushing for the East's top seed, Cavs post a 1-3 week. Which puts them closer to No. 5 than No. 1, with seven of the next eight on the road.

rankings.summaryHtml: As long as Jazz don't surrender HC advantage in Round 1 by letting Rockets pass them in the win column,  they can live with what happens in the rankings. Probably.

rankings.summaryHtml: Skiles was predictably enraged by that one-point loss at Memphis, but Bulls' last three Ws in an 8-3 month came by four points combined. Can't win every close one.
rankings.summaryText: Skiles was predictably enraged by that one-point loss at Memphis, but Bulls' last three Ws in an 8-3 month came by four points combined. Can't win every close one.

rankings.summaryHtml: The funny thing about Kobe's 53.6 ppg average during this historic run? Lakers have needed every point, only winning those five games by an average of 4.4.
rankings.summaryText: The funny thing about Kobe's 53.6 ppg average during this historic run? Lakers have needed every point, only winning those five games by an average of 4.4.

rankings.summaryHtml: Winning on LeBron's floor takes Iverson and Melo to 11-11 when both are in Nuggets' lineup, with Denver in the midst of a 6-2 uptick overall since its 1-3 start in March.
rankings.summaryText: Winning on LeBron's floor takes Iverson and Melo to 11-11 when both are in Nuggets' lineup, with Denver in the midst of a 6-2 uptick overall since its 1-3 start in March.

rankings.summaryHtml: What's the cure for Bargnani's appendectomy? An otherwise tidy 2-0 week to push Raps' division lead to 6½ games, lifting them to a season-high No. 3 in the East.

rankings.summaryHtml: First a 25-point loss to unraveling Indy? Then a 19-point blown lead at home to Philly? Yes, Mr. Wade. Heat were 11-3 without you, but they're ready for you now.

rankings.summaryHtml: The good Gilbert: Arenas' layup as time expired in Seattle marked his third buzzer-beating game winner of the season. No one else in the league has more than one.
rankings.summaryText: The good Gilbert: Arenas' layup as time expired in Seattle marked his third buzzer-beating game winner of the season. No one else in the league has more than one.

rankings.summaryHtml: The secret to finishing eighth? Even sans Cassell, banged-up Clips are now 5-0 in one-point games after winning in MIL . . . and after just one one-point W last season.
rankings.summaryText: The secret to finishing eighth? Even sans Cassell, banged-up Clips are now 5-0 in one-point games after winning in MIL . . . and after just one one-point W last season.

rankings.summaryHtml: Warriors are 8-2 with Baron back, but Clips are almost as hot. So this apparently won't be a replay of 10 years ago, when 36-46 was good enough for Clips to be No. 8.
rankings.summaryText: Warriors are 8-2 with Baron back, but Clips are almost as hot. So this apparently won't be a replay of 10 years ago, when 36-46 was good enough for Clips to be No. 8.

rankings.summaryHtml: Hornets started 8-3 with Peja playing and should get him back this week. Problem is, it's probably too late unless they win both of their remaining meetings with Clips.
rankings.summaryText: Hornets started 8-3 with Peja playing and should get him back this week. Problem is, it's probably too late unless they win both of their remaining meetings with Clips.

rankings.summaryHtml: Sixers are 8-4 in March, including wins over Jazz and Heat, after beating Phoenix on the last day of February. But even in the East, they appear out of playoff range.
rankings.summaryText: Sixers are 8-4 in March, including wins over Jazz and Heat, after beating Phoenix on the last day of February. But even in the East, they appear out of playoff range.

rankings.summaryHtml: Common sense says Nets vets are the most likely group out there to fall upwards into a playoff berth. But only one word can describe their recent play: <i>Lackluster.</i.>
rankings.summaryText: Common sense says Nets vets are the most likely group out there to fall upwards into a playoff berth. But only one word can describe their recent play: Lackluster.

rankings.summaryHtml: This'll only be the biggest week of No. 8 Magic's season so far, with games against their two closest pursuers: No. 10 Knicks (Monday in NY) and No. 9 Pacers (Friday).
rankings.summaryText: This'll only be the biggest week of No. 8 Magic's season so far, with games against their two closest pursuers: No. 10 Knicks (Monday in NY) and No. 9 Pacers (Friday).

rankings.summaryHtml: Who needs Crawford? Who needs D. Lee? Actually . . . Isiah misses both of them badly judging by Knicks' 1-5 record since he got that contract extension.
rankings.summaryText: Who needs Crawford? Who needs D. Lee? Actually . . . Isiah misses both of them badly judging by Knicks' 1-5 record since he got that contract extension.

rankings.summaryHtml: Kudos to Kings for stunning Suns despite losing K. Martin early. But with 40 losses overall, they've already clinched the club's worst record since going 27-55 in '97-98.
rankings.summaryText: Kudos to Kings for stunning Suns despite losing K. Martin early. But with 40 losses overall, they've already clinched the club's worst record since going 27-55 in '97-98.

rankings.summaryHtml: Before KG's buzzer-beater Sunday to beat Portland, Wolves' playoff push featured a 3-8 record in March, 12 losses in 16 games and one win in 13 road games.
rankings.summaryText: Before KG's buzzer-beater Sunday to beat Portland, Wolves' playoff push featured a 3-8 record in March, 12 losses in 16 games and one win in 13 road games.

rankings.summaryHtml: Only one team in a decade besides these Pacers slid from five games over .500 into a double-digit losing skid. Toronto was 29-21 in '01-02, then lost 13 straight.
rankings.summaryText: Only one team in a decade besides these Pacers slid from five games over .500 into a double-digit losing skid. Toronto was 29-21 in '01-02, then lost 13 straight.

rankings.summaryHtml: Blazers will not manage the 12-0 finish they need to finish at .500. But Roy has the ROY locked up and they'll certainly finish above Sonics, if nothing else.
rankings.summaryText: Blazers will not manage the 12-0 finish they need to finish at .500. But Roy has the ROY locked up and they'll certainly finish above Sonics, if nothing else.

rankings.summaryHtml: If (for some reason) you rank East contenders based on how they fare vs. Bobcats, Miami clearly has an edge. Bobs are 0-2 against Heat, 2-2 vs. Pistons and Cavs.
rankings.summaryText: If (for some reason) you rank East contenders based on how they fare vs. Bobcats, Miami clearly has an edge. Bobs are 0-2 against Heat, 2-2 vs. Pistons and Cavs.

rankings.summaryHtml: By following up their San Antonio breakthrough with three straight Ls, Celts have a sub-.300 winning percentage this late in the season for just the second time ever.
rankings.summaryText: By following up their San Antonio breakthrough with three straight Ls, Celts have a sub-.300 winning percentage this late in the season for just the second time ever.

rankings.summaryHtml: Bogut and Villanueva done for the year. Bucks' seven-game homestand is done, too. So routing Spurs in his debut figures to be Krystkowiak's highlight for a while.

rankings.summaryHtml: Joe Johnson believes he'll play again this season in spite of that calf injury. The committee's rooting for him, too, since we're also nursing soccer-induced calf trouble.

rankings.summaryHtml: Sonics' season only grows more painful: Ray Allen is done for the year and offsets his career-best scoring average (26.4 ppg) by playing a career-low 55 games.

rankings.summaryHtml: Uh-oh. Grizz have five games to go on a six-game trip and only 12 games left to avoid being the only team in the league this season that fails to win two in a row.
